definition: The group’s profit after costs and tax includes amounts attributable to outside owners of its subsidiaries.
location: Consolidated Financial Statements, PDF page 2, statement of profit and loss, and note 39 on PDF page 82.
notes: Profit belonging to shareholders of the parent company was ₹476.01 crore. This is above whole-group profit because other owners of subsidiaries were allocated a share of losses.
insight: CAMS describes mutual fund work, payments and other services in its business updates, but the annual accounts report their profit together.
